name: KedaiLink: grocery reorder bot (Malaysia)
expect: Strong idea, not yet registered. Expect mostly ✅ and CIP Spark eligible.
text:
KedaiLink helps small grocery shops in Kuala Lumpur reorder stock. Shop owners lose sales because they only notice empty shelves after customers ask. Our customers are independent sundry shops (kedai runcit) with 1 to 3 staff.

The solution is a WhatsApp bot: the owner sends a photo of the shelf, and we create a reorder list and send it to their usual wholesaler.

We interviewed 25 shop owners in Cheras and 18 said they would try it. We have a working prototype that 4 shops used for two weeks.

We are a team of 3: one ex-wholesaler sales rep and two software engineers. We charge wholesalers RM2 per order placed through the bot. We are not registered yet.

Next milestone: 20 paying shops by March 2027.

name: AgriSense: durian farm sensors (Malaysia)
text:
AgriSense helps durian farmers in Pahang, Malaysia detect root disease early. Farmers lose up to a third of their trees because disease is only spotted when leaves turn yellow. Our customers are small durian farms with 100 to 500 trees.

Our solution is a soil sensor plus a phone app that alerts farmers when moisture and fungus levels look dangerous.

We ran a pilot on 6 farms for 3 months and 5 farmers asked to keep using it. We have signed letters of intent from 2 farming cooperatives.

The main risk is sensor battery life in heavy rain, which we are testing now.

We are a team of 4: an agronomist, a hardware engineer and two software developers. We are a registered company (Sdn Bhd). We charge RM30 per sensor per month.

Next milestone: 50 paying farms by June 2027.

name: MediQueue: clinic booking (Indonesia)
expect: Early revenue, healthtech, Indonesia. Expect the Southeast Asia accelerator to match, not the Malaysia grant.
text:
MediQueue is a clinic booking app in Jakarta, Indonesia. Patients at small private clinics wait 2 to 3 hours because there is no booking system. Our target customers are independent clinics with 1 to 5 doctors.

The app lets patients book a time slot and get a WhatsApp reminder.

We have a working MVP used by 3 clinics, with 1,200 bookings last month. Clinics pay Rp 2,000,000 per month.

Our team of 2 founders includes a former clinic manager and a software engineer. We are not yet registered as a company.

Next milestone: 30 clinics by December 2026.
